description: Provision a Google Cloud Certificatemanager CertificateManagerDNSAuthorization via Config Connector. Fields mirror the certificatemanager.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 CertificateManagerDNSAuthorization spec.

description.description: A human-readable description of the resource.

domain.description: Immutable. A domain which is being authorized. A DnsAuthorization resource covers a single domain and its wildcard, e.g. authorization for "example.com" can be used to issue certificates for "example.com" and "*.example.com".

location.description: Immutable. Optional. Location represents the geographical location of the DnsAuthorization. If not specified, "global" is used.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

type.description: Immutable. Optional. The type of DNS Authorization. If not specified, "FIXED_RECORD" is used. Possible values: FIXED_RECORD, PER_PROJECT_RECORD.

title: GCP Certificatemanager CertificateManagerDNSAuthorization
